questions.question:

A) Alexander Norén won the Golf 2017 Masters Tournament.

B) In 2017, Daniel Ricciardo raced in Formula One for Mercedes.

C) In 2017, Pro Kabaddi League, Suraj Desai played for Jaipur Pink Panthers.
questions.solution:
• Sergio García won the Golf 2017 Masters Tournament. Thus, statement A is wrong.
 
• In 2017, Daniel Ricciardo raced in Formula One for Red Bull Racing. Thus, statement B is wrong.
 
• In 2017, Pro Kabaddi League, Suraj Desai played for Dabang Delhi. Thus, statement C is wrong.

questions.question:
Which of the statements given below is correct?

1. United Arab Emirates hosted the Badminton 2017 BWF World Senior Championships.

2. Johanna Konta won the Tennis 2017 Miami Open Women’s Singles.

3. Grigor Dimitrov won the Tennis 2017 US Open Men’s Singles.
questions.solution:
​The correct answer is __**Only B.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Badminton 2017 BWF World Senior Championships:-**

 
 
• It was held** from 11 – 17 September 2017.**
 
• 
 The **venue was Rajiv Gandhi Indoor Stadium, Kochi**.
 
 
• It was hosted by Kochi, Kerala, India.** Thus, statement A is wrong.**
 
• **India won 1 Gold, 4 Silver, and 16 Bronze. Total of 21 Medals.**
 
 
 
• **Tennis 2017 Miami Open Women’s Singles:-**
 
 
• It was **won by Johanna Konta Thus, statement B is correct**.
 
• **Caroline Wozniacki** was the runner-up.
 
 
 
• **Tennis 2017 US Open Men’s Singles.**
 
 
• It was held from **August 28 – September 10, 2017.**
 
• **It was the 137th edition.**
 
• It took place at **USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center, New York.**
 
• It **won by Rafael Nadal**** Thus, statement C is wrong.**

questions.question: Who won the Chess.com's 2020 Junior Speed Online Chess Championship after beating Russia's Alexey Sarana?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Nihal Sarin__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points __**

__
 
• Nihal Sarin won Chess.com's 2020 Junior Speed Online Chess Championship after beating Russia's Alexey Sarana.
 
 
• A chess child prodigy from Kerala.
 
• Nihal Sarin became India’s 53rd Grandmaster after attaining his third and final Grand Master-norm in the Abu Dhabi Masters
 
• He is only the third grandmaster from Kerala after GN Gopal and SL Narayanan.
 
• He is the twelfth youngest grandmaster in chess history.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Dommaraju Gukesh** (born 29 May 2006), commonly referred to as Gukesh D, is a chess player from India.

 
 
• At 12 years, 7 months and 17 days, D. Gukesh became India's youngest Grandmaster on 15 January 2019.
 
 
 
• **Sven Magnus Carlsen **is a Norwegian Chess Grandmaster.
 
 
• He is the current World Chess Champion, World Rapid Chess Champion, and World Blitz Chess Champion.
 
 
 
• **Raunak Sadhwani** became India’s 65th Grandmaster.
 
 
• He defeated Russian GM Alexander Motylev to become the Grandmaster at the age of 13 years.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian female wrestlers won a gold medal in the 59-kg weight category at the 2019 Dan Kovlov - Nikola Petrov tournament?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. **__Pooja Dhanda.__**

 
• Pooja Dhanda claimed gold in the 59kg category at the Dan Kolov-Nikola Petrov wrestling tournament in Ruse, Bulgaria. 
 
• Bajrang Punia also won the 65kg category gold at the Dan Kolov-Nikola Petrov wrestling tournament.
 
• Dhanda finished undefeated in the round-robin format of the competition which included a win over her compatriot Sarita Mor.

questions.question:
Which of the statements given below are correct?

A) In 2018 IPL auction, Delhi Daredevils retained Rishabh Pant.

B) In 2017, Daniel Ricciardo raced in Formula One for Red Bull Racing.

C) Lewis Hamilton won the Formula One 2017 Malaysian Grand Prix.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A and B.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Indian Premier League (IPL):-

 
 
• The men's T20 franchise Indian cricket league is called the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• The game comprises of ten teams, each from a different city and state, competing in it every year.
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) was founded by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in 2007.
 
• IPL typically takes place in the months of March through May every year in India and has a special window in the ICC Future Tours Programme.
 
• After Delhi Daredevils finished sixth in the 10th edition of the IPL, the franchise has chosen to retain three players from the 2017 squad. In the team **retention announcement in Mumbai on January 4th, 2018, Delhi Daredevils that the three players who will carry forward the next season will be Chris Morris, Rishabh Pant and Sheryas Iyer. **(Hence Statement A is correct)
 
 
 
• **Australian Grand Prix:-**
 
 
• It is **an annual motor racing event that is under contract to host Formula One until 2035.**
 
• In 2017, Daniel Ricciardo, who raced for Red Bull in the Australian GP formula one, stood 17th in the race. **(Hence Statement B is correct)**
 
 
 
• **Malaysian Grand Prix:-**
 
 
• **First held in 1999, **the race dropped off the F1 calendar after the 2017 event.
 
• Max Verstappen wins the Malaysian GP in 2017 by beating Lewis Hamilton. (Hence Statement C is incorrect)
